signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 3 US offices
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Product Ownership. Define the vision, roadmap and requirements for our AI layer, and own the tradeoffs between scope, quality and time.
Zero to One. Take the product from concept to a launched, multi-tenant application that many users and customer organizations log into.
AI Direction. Work with engineers on model selection, training, evaluation and deployment, and decide where AI belongs in the workflow and where it does not.
The Bridge. Translate between designers, engineers and executives so that everyone is building the same thing for the same reason.
Go-to-Market. Partner with leadership on launch, positioning and revenue for the product you build.

roles.title: AI Product Manager, Public Sector
roles.location: Washington, DC or San Francisco, CA

bullets: Become deeply fluent in the company’s evaluation, guardrail, and agent governance platform.
Build deep relationships with public sector customers, mission users, technical evaluators, and executive stakeholders to understand operational needs, constraints, and success…
Translate customer signal into product strategy, business cases, roadmap priorities, PRDs, and measurable product requirements.
Lead discovery, prototyping, and iteration for public sector use cases across AI evaluation, red-teaming, runtime controls, governance, observability, and agentic systems.
Partner with engineering, research, design, delivery, and go-to-market teams to prioritize and ship capabilities that solve real customer problems.
